caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The chair is rendered in dark brown tones with black accents and features curved rockers at the base, vertical slats forming the backrest, two armrests with gently curved ends, and turned supports connecting the various components. The seat, backrest top rail, and armrests show some subtle shading suggestive of wood grain. There are no other objects present in the composition, and the background is free from any additional decoration or detail.
title: Boston Rocker
